source_text: De duabus semis tribubus quae transierunt Iordanen, et de Iesu quomodo exaltavit eum Dominus, et quomodo populum circumcidit. De his qui mare rubrum transierunt Apostolus: Omnes in Moysen baptizati sunt in nube et in mari. De his qui Iordanen: omnes in Iesu baptizati sunt in Iordane — forma baptismi. Festinavit populus transire — nobis ad baptismum non otiose sed festinandum usque quo omnia transeamus. Transire est implere mandata: Beati pauperes spiritu; esurire iustitiam; lugere; mansueti; pacifici; persecutiones patientia. Cum festinatione transire Iordanen; postea cautela ne effundantur gressus.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning two half-tribes which crossed Jordan, and concerning Jesus how exalted him Lord, and how people he-circumcised. Concerning those who sea red crossed Apostle: All into Moses baptized were in cloud and in sea. Concerning those who Jordan: all into Jesus baptized were in Jordan — form of-baptism. Hastened people to-cross — to-us unto baptism not idly but it-must-be-hastened until all we-cross. To-cross is to-fulfill commands: Blessed poor in-spirit; to-hunger justice; to-mourn; meek; peaceful; persecutions by-patience. With haste to-cross Jordan; afterward caution lest be-poured-out steps.
pass_b_english: On the two and a half tribes who crossed the Jordan, on how the Lord exalted Jesus, and how he circumcised the people. Of those who crossed the Red Sea the Apostle says: [[All were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:2]]. Of those who crossed the Jordan we may say: all were baptized into Jesus in the Jordan — the form of baptism’s sacrament. [[The people hastened and crossed >> Bible:Joshua 4:10-11]] — so when we come to saving baptism we must not dawdle but hurry until we “cross” all that is commanded. To cross is to fulfill: [[Blessed are the poor in spirit >> Bible:Matthew 5:3]]; hunger for righteousness; mourn; become meek and peacemaking; bear persecutions with patience. Cross the Jordan with haste; afterward watch lest [[your steps almost slip >> Bible:Psalm 73:2]].
